# CallKaro

> CallKaro is an Android app for India that places real phone calls over the internet (Wi-Fi, 4G or 5G) to any Indian mobile or landline number. The person called gets a normal call on their SIM and does not need the app. Calls use credits: 1000 credits = 1 minute, billed per second; unanswered, busy or failed calls are free.

## Key facts
- Platform: Android 7.0 and newer. Distributed as an APK from https://callkaro.in (not on Google Play yet).
- Calls to: Indian mobile numbers (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL and others) and Indian landlines.
- Not for emergencies: 112, 100, 108 and short codes must be dialled from the phone dialer.
- Credits: buy minute packs (paid credits never expire) or earn free credits from rewarded videos, a daily spin wheel and a welcome bonus. Credits have no cash value.
- Login: email one-time code. Contacts are read on the phone only and never uploaded.
- In-call: mute, hold, speaker, Bluetooth, keypad (IVR), notes; Recent calls shows the exact charge.
- Languages: English and Hindi.

## Hindi summary
CallKaro ek internet calling app hai: Wi-Fi ya mobile data se kisi bhi Indian mobile ya landline number pe normal call karo. Saamne wale ko app ki zaroorat nahi. 1000 credits = 1 minute, per second billing, bina utha call free. Free credits: video dekh ke, daily spin aur welcome bonus.
